title: 45 business tables are duplicated between public and tenant_default with diverging columns
symptom: 45 table names exist in BOTH the public schema and the tenant_default schema of a freshly migrated database, including tenant, service_catalog, sessions, onboarding_registry, event_type_registry_producers, role_permissions and 39 others. The two copies diverge in columns: public.tenant has tenant_type (added by GBL-119) while tenant_default.tenant does not.
root_cause_analysis: GBL-prefixed migrations apply only to public; non-GBL migrations apply to every tenant schema. Tables created by early non-GBL migrations therefore got a copy in each tenant schema, and every later GBL-only ALTER landed on the public copy alone. The TestHarness search_path is tenant_default,public, so any unqualified reference silently resolves to the stale tenant_default copy. This is the anti-patterns.md entry on unqualified SQL in tests against GBL-migration effects (ISS-0089, GH #338), but the underlying schema duplication itself was never addressed, only individual call sites, repeatedly (ISS-0089, ISS-0126, ISS-0144, and again in ISS-0150 RC-3).
impact: A recurring, silently-wrong-schema failure mode that has now been patched call-site-by-call-site at least four times. Each recurrence costs a full investigation because the symptom (column X does not exist, on a column that demonstrably exists) misdirects toward migration bugs.
acceptance_criteria: A decision is recorded for each of the 45 duplicated tables: either it is genuinely per-tenant (and the public copy should be dropped) or it is a global registry (and the tenant_default copy should be dropped)
A migration removes the copies that should not exist, or a linter rejects unqualified references to any name that exists in both schemas
The SQL set-intersection of public and tenant_default table names returns only the intentionally-shared set
related: ISS-0150 / GH #482 - the run that surfaced this
notes: Filed per CLAUDE.md 'No Issue Left Local-Only' and the 'filed and forwarded, not fixed here' scope boundary. ISS-0150 fixed 3 root causes (33 blocks) with zero regressions; this cluster has a distinct root cause and belongs in its own run.
